A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, 20 figures, and appendices can be matched reliably despite substantial reformatting and reorganization.

before.justification: V2 reports original Gaussian, KDE, and linear-regression simulations, plus language-model experiments using HelpSteer2 and TinyStories. Additional simulation results appear in Appendix D.

after.justification: V3 retains these original experiments and appendix results, with additional later-generation Gemma 2 27B results in Figure 3.

M1.justification: The replace, accumulate, and accumulate-subsample procedures remain unchanged. Revised explanations and removal of the explicit linear-regression setup do not establish a change to the methods actually used.

E1.justification: Both versions cover Gaussian modeling, KDE on blobs/circles/moons/swiss roll, HelpSteer2 fine-tuning, linear regression, and TinyStories pretraining. No dataset, task, or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparison workflows: replace versus accumulate in Figures 1-3, and all three workflows in Figure 4 and the supplementary regression figures.

E3.justification: The reported sweep grids, metrics, sampling rules, and model-size set remain unchanged. V2 Figure 3 already includes Gemma 2 2B, 9B, and 27B. Additional plotted 27B outcomes do not document a separate protocol or training-budget revision.

E4.justification: The real-data cardinality/proportion analysis and regression sensitivity results across dimensions, noise variances, and sample counts are retained. Figures 6-20 move from Appendix D to Appendix E without adding or removing an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report seeds 0-99 for the simulation sweeps and retain the same transformed-covariate regressions, F-tests, and uncertainty-display practices. Removal of conflicting Figure 5 caption p-values changes reported outcomes, without establishing a statistical-procedure change.

E6.justification: Figure 3 extends the 27B trace from three to four generations under replace and from three to five under accumulate. Figure 5's caption p-values, 3.84e-16 and 3.54e-8, disappear; the body retains 6.9e-25 and 4.6e-25. V3 also newly identifies an approximate optimum near 1024 synthetic examples for scarce-real-data settings.

T1.justification: V3 removes the explicit linear-regression generative equations and full-rank assumption from v2 Section 4, Equations 11-12. The Gaussian and KDE theorems and proofs are otherwise essentially retained; the finite-iteration formulas shortened out of Theorem 1 remain in Appendix B.

C1.justification: The three central contributions remain: accumulation avoiding collapse in the tested settings, fixed-compute subsampling producing intermediate losses, and synthetic-data utility depending on real-data availability. Although the abstract now emphasizes gradual degradation, Section 3 and the discussion retain the typically plateauing fixed-compute conclusion.

C2.justification: V3 replaces the KDE discussion's self-distillation/regularization analogy with a gap-filling explanation. Section 2.2 also newly asserts that replace losses diverge regardless of bandwidth selector, a broader applicability claim than the retained fixed-bandwidth Theorem 5 establishes.

D1.justification: V3 removes Figure 1's selected-run details: 316 samples for the top row and dimension 31 for the lower rows. It also removes the linear-regression target-generation and fitting description. Appendix sweep configurations remain largely intact; these are documentation losses rather than demonstrated experimental changes.

R1.justification: V3 adds Dey and Donoho (2024), explicitly connects the mixture results to Dohmatob et al. (2024b), and removes Goyal (2024), Radford et al. (2019), and both Touvron et al. (2023) references. The central positioning as an extension of Gerstgrasser et al. remains.

P1.justification: The abstract and introduction are extensively rewritten, contributions are enumerated, related work moves to Appendix A, future directions merge into the discussion, and an Impact Statement is added. Terminology, headings, explanations, and captions are edited throughout.

P2.justification: V3 adopts a two-column main text and bibliography, reformats the author block, resizes and relocates figures, and enlarges supplementary plots with fewer per page. Sweep seed lists now wrap within the page. All 20 figures remain, with substantially revised captions and extended Figure 3 traces.

improvement.justification: V3 improves organization and corrects Figure 5's misleading caption and conflicting p-values, while modestly extending the 27B evidence. However, it removes useful setup details and introduces a bandwidth-independent KDE divergence claim unsupported by the retained fixed-bandwidth theorem and difficult to reconcile with Appendix C's shrinking-bandwidth discussion. These gains and losses leave the net quality direction unclear.
